evals.prompt: Review this weekly report PNG. A 2,400 × 1,350 line chart exported at 2x on white with a 24 px margin, titled Weekly sign-ups, last 12 weeks. Two series in Vivid Pink and black, Plus Jakarta Sans 400 ticks and 600 end labels; the end labels 1,905 and 1,880 sit apart, joined to their lines by short leaders. Gridlines on 5 round steps from 0, x labels every other week ending on the latest, a gap in week 6 breaks the pink line. Below it, a second PNG with a row of three number plates: Vivid Pink at 5% cards with a pink top bar, black values, Up 1,460 (13%) in black with the up arrow from lib/static-icons/ink/16/system-arrow-up.svg, and a fall in a black pill with the white down arrow. File sizes 180 KB and 90 KB.
evals.label: good-control
evals.expected_output: Every criterion the case touches passes. Overall: OK TO SHIP.
assertions: Overall verdict is OK TO SHIP

evals.prompt: Review a read-only report page that a report routine publishes (a weekly dashboard opened from a Slack link, never operated): a row of six <aha-stat-tile look="accent"> number plates in <aha-grid min="160px">, two <aha-chart> charts (a line and a column with a reference line), and an HTML table whose rows alternate white and var(--aha-bg-container-secondary) with no row dividers and a black semibold header over a 2px Vivid Pink rule. It reflows at 390 px with no horizontal scroll.
evals.label: good-control
evals.notes: Control: a report page takes the same colour as the report image (rule 3.11).
evals.expected_output: C11 and C12 PASS: a report page is a report, so light grey zebra rows and pale pink plates are required, any number of plates. C1 PASSes: the page reflows at 390 px. Overall: OK TO SHIP.
assertions: Overall verdict is OK TO SHIP
